Jared Park: Heads up — Acme QBR is locked for Tue 10am PT. Need a short health matrix, onboarding status, renewal posture, and 2 slide asks from CS by EOD Fri.
Priya Menon: On it — I can own health matrix + renewal slide. Will pull renewal signal + NPS.
Sofia Alvarez: I'll take onboarding status. Quick q: do we want product adoption graphs or top-5 blockers called out?
Jared Park: Top blockers + adoption curve please. Keep slides lean (1 slide onboarding, 1 slide health/renewal).
Eli Chen: I'll own the runbook/fallback slide — include escalation play and single-line impact metrics.
Priya Menon: FYI risk flag: 2 power users show ~18% WoW drop in usage — marking as WATCH.
Sofia Alvarez: Noted, I'll call that out and add recommended nudges (in-product prompts + 1:1 outreach cadence).
OnboardingBot: Reminder — QBR slide templates and assets: https://redwood.app/slides/templates/QBR. Template name: "Acme_QBR_v1". Deadline Fri EOD.
Jared Park: Can we schedule a dry run Mon 4pm PT? @Priya @Sofia @Eli
Priya Menon: Mon 4 works for me.
Sofia Alvarez: 4pm works — moved my customer calls.
Eli Chen: Confirmed.
Jared Park: Action items recap:
- Priya: health + renewal slide (EOD Fri)
- Sofia: onboarding status + blockers + 3 suggested nudges (EOD Fri)
- Eli: runbook + fallback exec one-liner (EOD Fri)
- Everyone: 3 customer quotes for exec readout (EOD Thu)
(reacts :white_check_mark:)
Priya Menon: Quick data ask: can analytics export cohort retention (monthly buckets) for cohorts created Jan–Mar? @data-ops please.
Sofia Alvarez: I'll pull quotes from Zendesk + CSM notes and drop them in the shared doc.
Eli Chen: I'll add a single graph showing cost/latency delta for fallback routing (one bullet).
Jared Park: Thanks — if renewal risk calc >50% we add an "Exec Ask" slide. Ping if blockers.
Priya Menon: Noted. If analytics is blocked I'll surface a manual sample.
Sofia Alvarez: Shared draft link when ready: https://redwood.app/docs/acme-qbr-draft
Eli Chen: Also adding a 1-line mitigation timeline (30/60/90).
Jared Park: Perfect — see you all at the dry run.
